metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds morning prayer, the board, and six lines to Anne.

yesterday: Master Thwaite opened on St Michael. The feast itself is tomorrow. You sat with your hand on your face, and the parish may call that devotion.
Sir John Spencer said "Good Lord, deliver us" to the book.
Mistress Ansell named Master Yaxley at a shilling. You said after Thursday, and the broth had sops in it.
Saturday's share was thirty-four shillings, the best since Whitsun. You would give half of it to chew.
The letter tells her to trust the boy, and that you have a tooth, and that the king is played on Thursday.
